title: Find the display name of users who posted comments on posts with view count
question: Find the display name of users who posted comments on posts with view counts between 200 and 300 in 2012, and who also have only one type of post history activity across all their posts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT u.XCL_055
FROM users u
JOIN comments c ON u.XCL_052 = c.XCL_010
JOIN posts p ON c.XCL_006 = p.XCL_026
WHERE p.XCL_030 BETWEEN 200 AND 300
  AND strftime('%Y', c.XCL_009) = '2012'
  AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT ph.XCL_017
    FROM postHistory ph
    GROUP BY ph.XCL_017
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph.XCL_013) = 1
  )
